FailRooms - Demo

A downloadable game for Windows

You're not trapped, you're just misplaced.


Survive the nightmare of incompetent architecture. Lose your mind in the Backrooms, an infinite dimension where suffocating terror collides head-on with terrible interior design.

  • Face the absurd: Wander through endless, nonsensical spaces. Climb stairs that lead straight into the ceiling, stare into bone-dry pools, and question the sheer madness of a toilet built for two.
  • Laugh until you scream: Feel the crushing tension of liminal isolation... right until you stumble into a completely ridiculous room. But don't drop your guard. This place uses your own laughter against you to strike when you least expect it.
  • Dodge the bizarre: Never trust an empty hallway. Ignore the fake doors. And whatever you do, stay away from that rubber duck. The shadows here hide dangers that are as deadly as they are ridiculous.


Will you find the exit, or will the FailRooms swallow you alive amidst its construction errors?

A short but atmospheric Backrooms game. There are quite a few funny and completely illogical moments, but honestly, they just add to the charm 😄

It’s mostly about exploring and walking around, with a nice focus on atmosphere. The game is pretty short, which is understandable since it’s a demo, but there are still some interesting and funny moments along the way.

Definitely curious to see what the project becomes in the full version!

Небольшая, но атмосферная игра про Бэкрумс. Здесь много забавных и совершенно нелогичных моментов, которые только добавляют игре своего шарма 😄

По сути, это небольшое исследование с упором на прогулку и атмосферу. Игра довольно короткая, что вполне ожидаемо для демо-версии, но за это время успевает подарить несколько интересных и смешных моментов.

Определённо хочется увидеть, во что проект превратится в полной версии!
